transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because people keep acting like I'm just imagining things. But I'm not. I know the hospital people... and some of the folks from the agency, too... they've been watching our house. And my cleaning routes at work. They're just doing it to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. So... that's why I'm here.
Do you ever hear voices or see things that other people around you do not seem to notice?

I... well, sometimes. I don't really know what other people notice. But... when the house is quiet, I do hear a woman's voice. Over by the kitchen window. She just... she tells me to check the locks, or to move his pills. It sounds clear, just like she's standing right there. But I don't really want to make a big deal out of it.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts about being watched and hearing that woman's voice?
I... I guess I don't know the exact day. But... probably about eleven months now. That's how long I've noticed them watching, anyway. And... the voice, too. About eleven months.
Have you experienced any significant periods where your mood felt extremely low or unusually high, to the point where it affected your daily life or sleep?

I... well, I suppose there are times when I feel... different. Like I have a lot of energy. I feel bright, and... strong. Like I can handle everything they throw at me. But... if my husband asks me too many questions, or if a client at one of the houses gets in my way... I get angry. I snap at them. Much harder than I should. I don't mean to, it just... happens.

Are these periods where you feel full of energy or irritable happening at the same time you are hearing the voice and feeling watched, or do you have these mood swings even when you aren't experiencing those other things?

I... well, they happen together, I suppose. Like... there was a few weeks where I hardly slept at all. I was just... going. From cleaning houses to running errands for the church, just constantly moving. And... during that time, I still heard her voice. And I still knew they were watching my routes. It all just... happens at once, sometimes.

Looking back at the entire eleven months, would you say you have had these periods of feeling very energetic or irritable for the majority of that time, or have they only been present for a small portion of it?

I... I suppose it's been most of it. For most of this whole... change. I've just been... keyed up. Irritable. Like I'm just driven to keep moving. Even in the stretches when things weren't at their absolute worst... I still felt that way. So... yes. Most of the time.

Aside from those times when you feel full of energy and irritable, have there been any periods during these past eleven months where you felt deeply sad, hopeless, or lost interest in almost everything?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really felt sad or... hopeless. I don't really have time for that. I just stay busy with the houses. So... no.

During those times when you felt very energetic and irritable, did you also notice that you were talking much faster than usual, or that your thoughts were racing so quickly that you couldn't keep up with them?

I suppose... yes. My mind just... it jumps around a lot. Like... I'll be thinking about the bills, and then Bible verses, and then I'm listening to my husband's breathing, and then I'm trying to figure out which house I need to clean next. It just goes so fast. I can't really... catch a thought long enough to finish it. It's just... a lot.

During those times when you felt full of energy and your thoughts were racing, did you ever feel like you were so energized that you couldn't function at work or that you had to be hospitalized because of your behavior?
No... I haven't been hospitalized. I just... I keep cleaning. I still go to work. It's just... I'm busy. That's all.
Are there any stretches of time during these eleven months where you felt like your energy levels were normal, but you were still hearing the voice and feeling like you were being watched?

I suppose... there was a time. A few weeks, maybe. I was sleeping a bit more... not rushing around as much. But... the voice was still there. By the kitchen window. And... I still knew the agency was watching us. So... yes.

During those times when your energy was high and your thoughts were racing, did you ever feel like you were so energized or irritable that you were doing things that were clearly out of character for you, such as spending money you didn't have or acting in ways that caused significant problems for you or your family?
No... I don't think so. I wouldn't... spend money like that. We don't have it to just spend anyway. I just... I stick to my cleaning. I don't cause problems.
